title: Lentil bolognese with wholemeal spaghetti
steps: Finely chop the onion, carrot, celery and garlic and sweat them in the oil for 5 minutes.
Crumble the tofu finely and fry it for 4 minutes, then briefly toast the tomato purée.
Add the rinsed lentils, passata, 250 ml water and oregano and simmer for 20 minutes until the lentils are soft.
Cook the spaghetti in salted water until al dente.
Toss with the sauce, season and serve with basil.
